GenAiFunction.description: Converts an Approved Quote/Media Plan into a Draft Order (Order, OrderItem, AdOrderItem). Only call this after the user has explicitly confirmed the conversion - this action requires Agentforce confirmation. This will fail if the underlying Quote is not already in Approved or Accepted status. The resulting Order is not pushed to any ad server.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: Convert Approved Media Plan To Order
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Converting the approved media plan to an order...
